question: The autobiography 'My Experiments with Truth' was originally written in which language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarati.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **'The Story of my Experiments with Truth'** is the autobiography of Gandhi.
 
• In which he tells about his life; right from his early life in Porbandar all the way to his youth in England and how he stuck to the power of truth.
 
• The book was **originally written in Gujarati.**
 
• It was translated by a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi, **Mr. Mahadev Desai.**
 
• This book is more like a window that lets the reader see through the life of a legend.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Story of My Experiments with Truth is the autobiography of Mahatma Gandhi, covering his life from early childhood through to 1921.
 
• It was written in weekly installments and published in his journal** Navjivan from 1925 to 1929.**
 
• Its English translation also appeared in installments in his other journal **Young India.**
 
• It was initiated at the insistence of** Swami Anand** and other close co-workers of Gandhi.
 
• **In 1998**, the book was designated as one of the **"100 Best Spiritual Books of the 20th Century".**
